_comment: meeting_v1 的样例闸门: 每条 offered sample 要么编译出一个数并由第二条手写 SQL 现场核对(route),
要么按名拒绝(refused_by_name)。路由 SQL 只读 meeting_hub_raw,只用于核对,不进入任何声明。
每场平均事项数 / 每场平均时长 见 _unresolved 说明（缺会议场次键,匹配器会把'每场'吃掉）。
场次类样例的手写路线都在 raw 上按 Q3 四元组去重，不经过任何视图：视图错了它们也会红。

samples.question: 会议场次（含面试/接待客户）是多少？

expect.route: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c0||'|'||c1||'|'||c4||'|'||c5||'|'||coalesce(c7,'') AS k FROM meeting_hub_raw) s
SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw
SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE not (c3 like '面试%' or c3 like '接待%')
SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE c3 LIKE '面试%' OR c3 LIKE '接待%'

samples.question: 有责任人的事项有多少条？

expect.route: SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE not (c11 is null or btrim(c11) in ('','无','—','-'))

samples.question: 有实质纪要的事项有多少条？

expect.route: SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE btrim(c10) not in ('','无','—','-') AND char_length(btrim(c10)) > 3

samples.question: 纪要缺失的事项有多少条？

expect.route: SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE c10 is null or btrim(c10) in ('','无','—','-')

samples.question: 提前完成的事项有多少条？

SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE c3 = '培训'

samples.question: 平均每条事项的会议时长

expect.route: SELECT avg(c6::numeric) FROM meeting_hub_raw

SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE translate(left(c12,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' and translate(left(c13,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' and translate(left(c12,10),'/','-')::date = translate(left(c13,10),'/','-')::date)::numeric / (SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE translate(left(c12,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' and translate(left(c13,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}'), 6)

SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE translate(left(c12,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' and translate(left(c13,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' and translate(left(c13,10),'/','-')::date > translate(left(c12,10),'/','-')::date)::numeric / (SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw WHERE translate(left(c12,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' and translate(left(c13,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}'), 6)
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c11 is null or btrim(c11) in ('','无','—','-'))::numeric / count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c10 is null or btrim(c10) in ('','无','—','-'))::numeric / count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw
SELECT c0, count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw GROUP BY 1
SELECT c9, count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw GROUP BY 1
SELECT c3, count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw GROUP BY 1
SELECT c11, count(*) FROM meeting_hub_raw GROUP BY 1

samples.question: 按厂区看无责任人占比

expect.route: SELECT c0, round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c11 is null or btrim(c11) in ('','无','—','-'))::numeric / count(*)), 6) FROM meeting_hub_raw GROUP BY 1

SELECT c0, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN translate(left(c12,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' and translate(left(c13,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' and translate(left(c12,10),'/','-')::date = translate(left(c13,10),'/','-')::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN translate(left(c12,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' and translate(left(c13,10),'/','-') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) FROM meeting_hub_raw GROUP BY 1

samples.question: 人时是多少？
samples._why: manHours: 库里没有工时/人数明细，只能给事项条数;声明为拒绝而非代理指标

samples.question: 会议场次数是多少？

expect.route: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c0||'|'||c1||'|'||c4||'|'||c5||'|'||coalesce(c7,'') AS k, min(c3) OVER (PARTITION BY c0,c1,c4,c5,coalesce(c7,'')) AS t FROM meeting_hub_raw) s WHERE s.t NOT IN ('面试','接待客户')

samples._why: 旧版这里是拒绝（c2 是行号）；Q3 确认会议键四元组后场次可数：1785 个键的去重计数由本条手写路线钉住

samples.question: 平均参会人数是多少？
samples._why: avgAttendees: 没有参会人数字段

samples.question: 平均偏差天数是多少？
samples._why: avgCloseDelayDays: 需要逐条计划/实际差值聚合，未声明该指标

samples.question: 重复议题率是多少？
samples._why: repeatedTopicRate: 事项文本无法稳定识别“重复议题”，业务未给判定口径

samples.question: 会议效能指数是多少？
samples._why: efficiencyIndex: 业务未定义指数公式，禁止自造

samples.question: 泛指派占比是多少？
samples._why: vagueOwnerRate: “泛指派”的判定词表未由业务确认，不设阈值

samples.question: 纪要有内容率是多少？
samples._why: noteContentRate: 与 notedItemCount 的重叠口径未确认，避免两个数打架

samples.question: 最近30天有多少条决议事项？

expect.refused_by_name: does not support the TimeWindow slot

samples._why: 导出是 2025-12-01 起的历史快照，'最近30天' 取决于导出时点，任何窗口数都会随重导漂移;声明 :supportsSlot 之前不答

samples.question: 平均每场会议时长是多少？

expect.route: SELECT avg(d) FROM (SELECT max(c6::numeric) AS d, min(c3) AS t FROM meeting_hub_raw GROUP BY c0,c1,c4,c5,coalesce(c7,'')) s WHERE s.t NOT IN ('面试','接待客户')

samples._why: 先在 raw 上按会议键聚合出每场时长再取平均，与视图路线独立

samples.question: 每场会议平均参会人次是多少？

expect.route: SELECT round((SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_hub_attendance WHERE meeting_type NOT IN ('面试','接待客户'))::numeric / (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c0||'|'||c1||'|'||c4||'|'||c5||'|'||coalesce(c7,'') AS k, min(c3) OVER (PARTITION BY c0,c1,c4,c5,coalesce(c7,'')) AS t FROM meeting_hub_raw) s WHERE s.t NOT IN ('面试','接待客户')), 6)

SELECT c0, count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c0,c1,c4,c5,coalesce(c7,'') AS lead, min(c3) OVER (PARTITION BY c0,c1,c4,c5,coalesce(c7,'')) AS t FROM meeting_hub_raw) s WHERE s.t NOT IN ('面试','接待客户') GROUP BY 1

samples.question: 按会议类型看会议场次

expect.route: SELECT meeting_type, count(DISTINCT meeting_key) FROM meeting_hub_attendance WHERE meeting_type NOT IN ('面试','接待客户') GROUP BY 1
SELECT round(sum(duration_minutes)::numeric/60, 6) FROM meeting_hub_attendance WHERE meeting_type NOT IN ('面试','接待客户')
SELECT site_code, round(sum(duration_minutes)::numeric/60, 6) FROM meeting_hub_attendance WHERE meeting_type NOT IN ('面试','接待客户') GROUP BY 1
